message: 探検発見、僕達の町

name: Synn
message: 「I ended up coming to school out of sheer reflex, even though today's Sunday.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, nobody's here.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Sneaking into an empty school building gets me all excited.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「We're the Student Council, so act like we belong here.」

name: Synn
message: 「Still, Ria-senpai told us to at least take today off from Student Council activities.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「What happens if we don't take the day off?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「We'll get chewed out big time.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Does that taste good?」

name: Synn
message: 「It means she'll get mad at us.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Eek! Senpai-san will scold us~」

name: Synn
message: 「People who usually smile all the time tend to be the scariest when they actually get mad, after all.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Uuu~. Even angels stay away from danger, yes they do.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I don't wanna get yelled at either, so I think I'll help out around the house.」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, it's been a while since you did that.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yeah, yeah. I've been busy lately, so figured I would once in a while.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Working hard even on your day off~~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, it's surprisingly not that bad. See ya.」
In the end, Lolotte and I were the only ones left.

name: Lolotte
message: 「President-san. Do you have any plans after this today?」

name: Synn
message: 「Plans?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes, that's right.」
Plans, plans...
I... I don't have any!? I have no plans!?
I never noticed because I was always working part-time jobs until now, but I have nothing to do on my day off!!
Woohoo!!

name: Synn
message: 「None at all, of course. Because I'm the Student Council President!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「If there are no Student Council activities, it's a day off, right? That said, isn't having nothing to do boring in its own way?」

name: Synn
message: 「...Yeah, you're right. I finally got to start living a sparkling school life. Having nothing to do now would be...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Let's enjoy our youth even more!」
Lolotte is really into it.
C-Could this be my chance to have a fun time with Lolotte!?

name: Synn
message: 「U-Um, Lolotte--」

name: Lolotte
message: 「So, you see, if you're free, why don't we go exploring together?」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh? Ex... ploring?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes, exploring♪」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I always make my days off 'Exploration Days,' you know.」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh~」

name: Lolotte
message: 「There are mountains of things I don't know yet. After all, it hasn't even been a year since I came down to this town.」

name: Synn
message: 「Came down?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Awawa, I mean came, stayed, and settled right in!」

name: Synn
message: 「So, what do you actually do on this exploration?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Through sheer initiative, I transform unknown things into known entities.」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm, I see. Basically, you go to unfamiliar places and broaden your horizons.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes. That's exactly right♪」

name: Synn
message: 「So, what are we doing with these posters?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I thought we could spread the word about KiraFes while we're out exploring.」
She's pretty quick on her feet.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Then let's be off. Let's go!!」
Lolotte grabs my hand, and--
In an instant, the scenery warped.

name: Synn
message: 「Wha--!! Lolotte, wait!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Don't just stop out of nowh--」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Oh, right, right. I forgot something very important.」

name: Synn
message: 「Urgh...」

name: Synn
message: 「Whoa!! What is it now!?」
Right in front of us, a visibly expensive-looking car screeched to a halt.
Then a figure leaped out of the driver's seat, rolled three times, and dropped into a crawl.

name: Synn
message: 「Eek!!」

name: Riesling
message: 「Please leave Milady's safety to this humble Riesling Tooyama.」

name: Synn
message: 「H-Hey, that's dangerous!! Please give yourself more room when you stop!」

name: Riesling
message: 「Rest assured. I stop with pinpoint precision, so the likes of Riesling Tooyama has no need for a margin of error.」

name: Synn
message: 「More importantly, that gun is the most dangerous thing here, so please put it away!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Jiiya. Today I'm going exploring with the President~」

name: Riesling
message: 「...Understood.」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, we don't plan on going anywhere dangerous, so I think we'll be fine.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「President. If you don't say that with confidence, Jiiya won't be convinced.」

name: Synn
message: 「We'll be fine!!」

name: Riesling
message: 「You may relax your shoulders. Tensing up only creates a risk of injury.」
Even if he tells me that, the pressure is insane!!

name: Riesling
message: 「Should anything happen to Milady, please contact me here.」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, thank you very much.」
It was the exact moment I reached out to take the business card.
A razor-sharp blade sprang out from the edge of the paper!!

name: Riesling
message: 「Please use this in case of an emergency.」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm not gonna use it!」

name: Riesling
message: 「Now then, please continue enjoying your exploration. Excuse me.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Have a safe trip back, Jiiya.」

name: Riesling
message: 「Yes, Milady.」
He really didn't need to drift in such a narrow alley...

name: Lolotte
message: 「Come along, Mr. President♪ We're going at a full dash~~\s04」

name: Synn
message: 「W-Waaah!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Slap, slap.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hey, Angel. You're just putting up posters. How is any of this exploring? You're half-assing both of 'em.」

name: Synn
message: 「For a panda, you're actually making sense...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「An angel bestows two gifts upon the world.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Wait, what are you making me say--!!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Still, going around a residential area of all places... I doubt we're gonna find anything interesting here.」

name: Synn
message: 「You think so? Glittering residences. Manicured alleyways. The gardeners' artistry catches the eye. Wouldn't there be plenty to discover?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Angel's a rich girl, ain't she? This level of bourgeois flair ain't no big deal to her.」

name: Synn
message: 「Right, she is...」
According to rumor, she's even richer than Ria-senpai. After all, she even has her own personal butler.
To think she could be satisfied with just this--

name: Lolotte
message: 「Mr. President!! There's a cute little guard doggy over here!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」
More of a puppy than a guard dog.

name: Paqy
message: 「Letting a toy poodle roam free like this--this place really is a lawless zone.」

name: Synn
message: 「Is it?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I see. So a guard doggy is necessary to uphold the law.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Not 'this dog is an outlaw,' idiot. I'm saying it's weird that an indoor dog is wandering around outside.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hmm, hmm.」

name: Paqy
message: 「If you don't even know that much, I'm starting to doubt whether you're really a rich girl at all.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Here, boy, come here~」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hey, don't ignore me!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ah, oh my.」

name: Synn
message: 「L-Lolotte?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ehehe. I held out my finger and got licked all over.」

name: Synn
message: 「Wha... oh, that's all.」
It startled me when she suddenly let out such a sultry voice.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Getting my finger licked sends shivers down my spine~~ It's so strange.」

name: Synn
message: 「Doesn't it just tickle?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Nothing happens when I lick it myself, though.」

name: Synn
message: 「That's because you're being licked in places you can't predict.」

name: Paqy
message: 「That's just common sense.」

name: Synn
message: 「I wouldn't go that far, though.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You say that, yet the things I don't know are overflowing like running water.」

name: Synn
message: 「R-Running water...?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Therefore, I am well aware that I lack common sense.」

name: Synn
message: 「You're so humble, Lolotte.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That is precisely why I need to make all sorts of discoveries in order to gain common sense in the Human World!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Because there are still sooo many things I don't know sleeping in this world!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, yeah. That's a great attitude.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Though really, it's just because it's fun.\s04」

name: Synn
message: 「You're so honest, Lolotte.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Goodbye, Mr. Toy Poodle♪」

name: Synn
message: 「That should do it for the posters. Lolotte, next is--」

name: Synn
message: 「Whoa there!!」
Being dragged along reminds me just how energetic Lolotte is.
Normally she's still on the quiet side. Maybe her limiter comes off when it's just the two of us.

name: Synn
message: 「Still, I feel like we've been here plenty of times preparing for KiraFes...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「When we go for Student Council activities, it's always on a weekday, isn't it?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, yeah.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「We don't really come here on holidays, after all.」

name: Synn
message: 「True. There are way more people around.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「The scenery and atmosphere that shift depending on the time and date you visit. That is the clue to new discoveries.」

name: Synn
message: 「Huuuh~~」

name: Lolotte
message: 「For example, that ramen shop over there. They always serve lunch, yet they aren't open today.」

name: Synn
message: 「Because it's a holiday.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That 'difference' is what's important.」

name: Synn
message: 「Why are you so fixated on differences?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「There were no differences in my hometown, you see.」

name: Synn
message: 「What do you mean...?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「There was no passage of time.」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It was a place with no four seasons, and no morning, noon, or night.」

name: Synn
message: 「You mean like somewhere super far north or south?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Somewhere much farther away. It's surely a place you don't know, President.」

name: Synn
message: 「Like Heaven?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「N-N-No, it's not!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Time doesn't change, huh. I can't imagine that at all.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It was boring. Because nothing ever changed, after all.」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm. True. Still, aren't there good things about that in its own way?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Why do you think so?」

name: Synn
message: 「Time not passing means you can live for a really long time, right?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Perhaps so. However, what meaning is there in living without doing anything or feeling anything...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Right now, this feeling of time moving forward is just so enjoyable I can't help myself.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Doing Student Council activities together with everyone truly makes me feel that.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. Ever since I became Student Council President, I've felt like time passes faster too.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That's just how fulfilling and fun it is.」

name: Synn
message: 「They do say time flies when you're having fun.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Indeed. It's already lunchtime.」

name: Synn
message: 「Should we get food somewhere...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「President!! I have a proposal right about now. I would like to eat something called 'fahst food.'」

name: Synn
message: 「Fast food. Well, there is a place around here.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「If I recall, it's somewhere around here... Oh, found it! You take minced mouse meat and--wait, mouse meat!?」

name: Synn
message: 「No, no! Where'd you hear that rumor? You eat proper meat patties sandwiched between bread.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「A meat patty!?」

name: Synn
message: 「It's called a hamburger. And you can eat one for just 100 yen!!」
This is easy on the wallet, too.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Can I buy it with a 500-yen coin as well?」

name: Synn
message: 「What!? With that, you could buy five of them!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Then it's settled!! Let's go at high speeding!! Come on, hurry!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Actually, it's right in front of us.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Oh my.」
For now, I bought a cheeseburger and a chicken burger that I could get for 100 yen each.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Then, five of them, please.」

name: Synn
message: 「You're gonna eat that much?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Change is a nuisance, after all.」

name: Synn
message: 「W-Well, she is a noble lady... Which one do you want to eat?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I'd like the hamburger steak♪」

name: Synn
message: 「Here you go.」
I toss the bag with the hamburger inside lightly onto her hand.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Um... are there no chopsticks or forks?」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, right, right. With this, you open the bag like this, open your mouth wide--」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Huh? A-Aaaah!」

name: Synn
message: 「Chomp, munch, munch...

name: Synn
message: Delicious!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Y-You actually do... something so unladylike~~\s01」

name: Synn
message: 「Look at everyone else. They're all doing it, right?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「When in Rome, my cheeks turn crimson.\s03」

name: Synn
message: 「It's only embarrassing at first. Come on, give it a try.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Okay... Ba-dump. Aaaah, chomp.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Whoa~~. It's super delicious~~」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. Tasty as ever.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Chowing down like this is strictly forbidden during my usual meals, after all. Just thinking about it makes my heart race.」

name: Synn
message: 「And the price is a great deal, too.」

name: Paqy
message: 「It's what you call junk food, ya know.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「What did you say!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Junk or jump, good food is good food.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Nobody said it tastes bad. It's just, when you think about health, you can't help but...」

name: Synn
message: 「You sure sweat the small stuff for a panda.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「If you want some, I'll share one of mine with you.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Ooooh, how thoughtful!! Just what you'd expect from an angel!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Bread and affection are meant to be shared. And I am not an angel. Munch, munch.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It's delicious, isn't it, Mr. President.\s04」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-Yeah!」
To think the day would come when I'd get to eat fast food together with a girl like this.
Could this really be the sparkling school life I've always dreamed of!?

name: Lolotte
message: 「Being like this makes it seem just like we're on a date.」

name: Synn
message: 「A d-date!?」
I see, so this is what they call a date.

name: Lolotte
message: 「However, this is not a date.」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh. I-Is that so.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「This is an expedition, so it is not a date. To begin with, a date is--」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Defined as a man and a woman arranging a time and place in advance to meet.」

name: Synn
message: 「W-Well, that's true, but...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I wonder if dates are actually fun~? If you're just meeting up, it doesn't really seem all that enjoyable to me...」

name: Synn
message: 「Th-That's not true at all!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Then what specifically do people do on one?」

name: Synn
message: 「W-Well, that's... that's!!」

name: Synn
message: 「First, when you meet up, you hold hands and stuff, and go hang out at an amusement park together.」

name: Synn
message: 「And then you eat a homemade bento together, and take a cozy nap side by side.」

name: Synn
message: 「After watching a beautiful sunset together, next you go to a restaurant and eat a delicious beefsteak!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ooh~~!! That sounds somehow quite fun~~」

name: Synn
message: 「Right, right? Soy sauce, right.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It would be nice if I could go on a proper date with you someday, Mr. President.」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh!! C-Could that mean... ba-dump, ba-dump.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I'd love to eat my fill of this delicious 'beefsteak' thing♪」
Food over romance, huh......

name: Lolotte
message: 「Before joining the Student Council, I used to spend my days off and after-school hours going out exploring.」

name: Synn
message: 「So because of Student Council activities, you haven't been able to go exploring anymore.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「No, not at all. In the Student Council, there are so many discoveries I could never make on my own.」

name: Synn
message: 「I see. I'm glad to hear that.」
While the two of us spent the time chatting, it grew dark before we knew it.

name: Synn
message: 「Lolotte, shouldn't you head back soon before Riesling starts worrying?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ah, you may be right. Thank you for your consideration.」

name: Synn
message: 「Ahaha, honestly I wish I could spend more time having fun with you, though......\s01」

name: Lolotte
message: 「President?」

name: Synn
message: 「Aaah!?」
I blurted out what I was thinking without filtering it, but thinking about it normally, that sounded completely like I have feelings for Lolotte!?
Me having feelings for Lolotte...... Well, she is cute and a really sweet girl, sure.

name: Lolotte
message: 「President, is something the matter?」
Seeing how completely oblivious she is, maybe she's only interested in how the world changes and has zero interest in me as a person......

name: Lolotte
message: 「Heehee, you're a funny President♪」
I'm supposed to be her upperclassman, yet I'm being so pathetic. At this rate, instead of looking up to me, she's going to despise me.
Alright, I'll work harder and harder to become a Student Council President that Lolotte can respect!!
And I'll become a man who can catch Lolotte's interest.
If I do that, then once again, I'll be able to spend time with Lolotte like this--

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hello, Jiiya? Right now, I'm at the park near the sea--」

name: Synn
message: 「Hm?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Something just went 'whoosh' across the sky.」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, a shooting star.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It's so pretty~~」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, yeah. By the way, aren't you going to answer your phone?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Aah!! I'm so sorry, Jiiya. Please come pick me up.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I can't believe something so pretty and wonderful could be a threat to the world.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah... though we still don't know what might happen.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It's strange. From what I've heard, it shouldn't actually cause any trouble.」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh? Re-Crea won't?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes. Because it's just a passing phenomenon.」

name: Synn
message: 「Wait a minute. How do you even know about that, Lolotte?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hweh?」

name: Synn
message: 「That Re-Crea isn't a big deal. Even I didn't know about it until just recently.」
Even though I'm supposed to be the Demon Lord.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ah!! Aaahhh--th-that is... um... uuuumm.」

name: Synn
message: 「Don't tell me your curiosity got the better of you and you researched a ton at the library!?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes!! That is exactly right.」

name: Synn
message: 「Though, I doubt the library even has books like that.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Geez!! Don't just shoot me down right away!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「U-Uuuumm. That information, you see. It's all written in a guidebook!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ooh, sounds like an amazing book. Show it to me sometime.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I-I can't do that. Or rather, it's written in my native language, so you wouldn't be able to read it!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, right. That's awesome, being bilingual.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ahem, indeed it is.」

name: Riesling
message: 「My lady. I have come to pick you up.」

name: Synn
message: 「Whoa!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It's rare for you to be late, Jiiya. Did you go somewhere?」

name: Riesling
message: 「Yes. To hunt down tonight's dinner.」

name: Synn
message: 「H-Hunt?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Well then, let us head back. President, thank you so very much for today.」

name: Synn
message: 「Thank you too.」

name: Riesling
message: 「Did you enjoy yourself?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Oh, immensely! It was such a meaningful day. After all, I even ate a hamburger!」

name: Riesling
message: 「Seeing that prisoner uniform reminds me of my past self.」
Is he talking about the mascot character?

name: Lolotte
message: 「Next time, let us go eat beefsteak together.」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Let's eat together until we're completely full!」

name: Synn
message: 「D-Does that mean... could it be...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes! Not an expedition, but a promise for a date!」

name: Synn
message: 「O-Oh! Ooooh!」
Yes! I get to go on a date. A date with Lolotte!
Wait, how much does beefsteak even cost, though... I-I've gotta save up some money before then.

name: Synn
message: 「Eek! What are you doing?!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Heehee. Really, Butler, getting jealous like that is terribly childish of you.」
That was jealousy!?

name: Lolotte
message: 「Now then, let us be off. Aah, my stomach is already positively famished~」

name: Riesling
message: 「Tonight's dinner shall be Matsusaka beefsteak.」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh!? Isn't that beefst--」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ooh~~ Well, well. Has it not been an entire week since we last had it? How exciting~~」

name: Synn
message: 「Matsusaka after just one week!?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Mr. President. Let's meet again tomorrow, okay? Good night♪」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-Yeah... good night.」

name: Riesling
message: 「Excuse me.」
I fall to my knees on the spot, completely deflated.

name: Paqy
message: 「Talk about heartless.」

name: Synn
message: 「Awoooo!!」
